summary: The worker tests directly use Cloudflare's Vitest pool, whose 0.20.0 release removes several Miniflare override options; the supplied Vite notes do not describe a repository-specific change.

findings.title: Check Cloudflare test-pool overrides
findings.impact: The worker Vitest configuration imports cloudflareTest directly, so any use of the removed Miniflare override options in that configuration would block the test upgrade.
recommendedChecks: Inspect the complete worker Vitest configuration for wrappedBindings, cacheWarnUsage, fetchMock, containerEngine, or cache overrides, then run the existing worker test command.

omittedConcerns: Specific Vite 8.1-to-8.2 impacts are omitted because the bounded official excerpts only link to a changelog and contain no change details.
Cloudflare options not shown in the supplied repository excerpt are treated as a check, not claimed as current usage.
